response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 20 years of diverse technical experience and current exposure to AI infrastructure at re:cinq, he significantly falls short of the core requirement: 8+ years building production-grade AI-driven solutions. His AI experience is limited to approximately 16 months focused on infrastructure tooling and MCP frameworks rather than designing and deploying production AI systems. Critical technology gaps compound this: Python is not mentioned despite being explicitly required, and there is no demonstrated expertise in vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM optimization.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering foundation with 20 years of experience across web, mobile, and systems; multiple staff-level positions demonstrate technical leadership capability
Current role at re:cinq provides direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP development, showing recent domain engagement and relevance
Exceptional TypeScript and Node.js expertise with proven cloud platform experience (AWS CDK); demonstrated ability to handle complex architectural challenges
concerns: Critical experience gap: only ~16 months in AI/GenAI space (April 2025-present) versus required 8+ years building production AI solutions; insufficient depth for staff-level GenAI role
Missing key required technologies: no Python experience mentioned; no demonstrated knowledge of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM optimization techniques
Current AI experience focused on infrastructure and tooling rather than building, deploying, and optimizing production agentic workflows for customers
